scope: read-only host observations; external mutation-test build was not stopped or altered

io_sample.note: Process accounting can include waited children; do not sum as disjoint disk throughput.

interpretation: Trials overlapping the external build can be affected by shared-host CPU and I/O contention. The host counters independently record stalls. This is not proof of an exact causal contribution.
start_time_precision: Approximately one second, derived from proc uptime and process start ticks
